parameterSet.name: builtin-nn
parameterSet.title: Built-in nearest-neighbour model (Turner 1999 subset)
parameterSet.parameters: Turner 1999 (Mathews et al. 1999, doi:10.1006/jmbi.1999.2700) stacking and loop-initiation tables, 37 °C
included: hairpin, bulge and interior loop initiation with log extrapolation beyond 30 nt
Ninio asymmetry (0.5 kcal/mol per nt, max 3.0)
terminal AU/GU penalty (0.5 kcal/mol per helix end)
linear multiloop a = 3.4, b = 0, c = 0.4 kcal/mol
